_comment: Sparse baselines the ladder is measured against. Transcribed from EAST

the 99.99% cell moved from 70.57 to 62.12 between them.
source: Li, Durrant, Markovic, Huang, Kundu, Chen, Yin, Leontidis, "Pushing the Limits of Sparsity: A Bag of Tricks for Extreme Pruning", TMLR 2025 (arXiv:2411.13545v4)

protocol.lr_schedule: CONTRADICTORY IN SOURCE: appendix Table B.1 says 10x[75,150]; main text says 10x at 1/2 and 3/4 of training (=125, 187)
protocol.init: UNSTATED in the paper; the CIFAR DST literature trains from scratch
protocol.prunes_classifier: UNSUPPORTED by the paper text -- "classifier", "last layer", "final layer" and "output layer" have zero occurrences. Must be read off the ES2/ITOP code.

_anchor_note: The ladder anchors at resnet34/cifar10 @ 0.999, where RigL is 85.71+/-0.23 and EAST 86.99+/-0.32. That pair is CONFIRMED and it is indeed the 99.9% level. Note RigL collapses to random at 99.99% (10.03) while EAST holds 62.12, so the 99.99% column is a mixture and must not be summarised with a mean +/- std -- see the plan on median/IQR/collapse-rate reporting.
